headline: Tourism Finance Corporation submits related party transaction details to NSE
summary: Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited has submitted its disclosures regarding related party transactions to the stock exchange. The filing details business dealings between the company and its related entities as required by regulatory norms. For Indian retail investors, such compliance filings offer transparency on internal dealings but typically have no immediate impact on share price or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate stock impact

headline: Tourism Finance Corporation of India files integrated financial documents
hook: Routine regulatory submission from Tourism Finance
summary: Tourism Finance Corporation of India has submitted its integrated financial filing as per regulatory requirements. The filing provides standard disclosures regarding the company's financial status during the period. Such periodic filings are mandatory for all listed entities on the NSE. Retail investors should check the official exchange portals for detailed balance sheet metrics and cash flows.
why_it_matters: Periodic filings offer data points for existing shareholders.

headline: Parkash Chand resigns as non-executive director of TFCI
hook: Board departure at Tourism Finance Corporation
summary: Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited has announced that Mr Parkash Chand has resigned from his position as a Non-Executive Director. The resignation takes effect from October 13, 2026. No immediate replacement or reason for the departure was disclosed in the filing. Retail investors track board changes for potential shifts in corporate governance.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no immediate impact on share value.
